ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering COVID-19 Relief Fund Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of COVID-19 relief fund fraud, including the use of shell companies and other tactics to launder money and conceal fraudulent activity.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records research
questions: How much money has been stolen from COVID-19 relief funds?
What tactics are being used to launder money and conceal fraudulent activity?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of public records and data can help identify patterns and connections between entities involved in COVID-19 relief fund fraud. This story has the potential to expose widespread abuse of government programs and hold those responsible accountable.
